description: Replace the build binary of an EXISTING software with a new version. Use this when a tool already exists and you want to ship a new release or demo build. DO NOT use this for a brand-new tool that has never been submitted — use submit_new_software for that. To change only metadata (title, price, description) without uploading a binary, use set_metadata instead. Use list_my_software to recover the software_id if you do not have it. Handles the presign → direct R2 upload → finalize flow, so large builds do not hit the upload timeout. Sending channel "release" puts the tool back into review; channel "demo" publishes a demo build without touching the live listing. Rate limit: 5 updates per tool per 24 h (shared with set_metadata); this tool checks the budget before uploading, so an exhausted quota costs you nothing. check_review_status shows the remaining budget. Pass the storage_path from precheck_build instead of file_path to avoid uploading the same ZIP twice. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

arch.description: CPU architecture; x64/amd64 and arm64 aliases are accepted

change_message.description: Changelog note shown to buyers after approval

entrypoint.description: Path to the main binary inside the ZIP; auto-detected if omitted

file_path.description: Absolute path to the build ZIP on disk. Omit when passing storage_path.

storage_path.description: storage_path from a previous precheck_build response - reuses that upload instead of sending the same ZIP again.

version.description: Semver, e.g. "1.7.5". A pre-release suffix such as "1.0.0-beta.1" is allowed here.

name: update_software
title: Update existing Crela software with a new build
